description: ADR 0158 ballistic check: the coupled combination (cargo24) is lifted 1.0 m above its equilibrium pose and released at 30 km/h, no throttle. While nothing touches the ground (no wheel ray, landing gear or collider contact) only gravity, aero drag and internal fifth-wheel forces act: E = KE + PE must not grow and the combined CoM must accelerate at g (drag bound below). Then it lands on its wheels without the chassis touching. Note (ADR 0158 Open): after the 1 m drop the combination rebounds strongly (first apex returns ~80 % of the drop energy) - heavy-landing damping is a separate question, not checked here.
spec: ADR 0158 (F2 follow-up): energy and ballistics in free flight

checks.source: the drop really is a flight: free fall of ~0.9 m (wheels hang below the static pose) lasts ~sqrt(2*0.9/9.81) = 0.43 s; require >= 0.3 s
no energy source in free flight: E = KE + PE must not grow between samples
|a_com - g| <= aero drag 0.5*rho*CdA*v^2/M: rho 1.2, CdA <= 7.5 m^2 (tractor 6.0 + trailer 1.5, VehicleDefinition/TrailerDefinition), v <= 9 m/s, M >= 30 t -> 0.0122 m/s^2; limit 0.05
lands on the suspension: chassis colliders do not reach the road (bumper bottom 0.35 m)
no fall-through: the tractor CoM (1.05 m static) may dip on the bump stops at the 1 m-drop landing (measured 0.737 m) but stays well above the road
coupling holds through a 1 m-drop landing (4.4 m/s impact; measured 7.5 mm, driving limit is 5 mm), no blow-up
